system.description:
• Effect: Whenever you choose the free route to Metamagic through Wild Surge (below) rather than paying with Spellburn, the GM rolls d20 in secret on the Corruption Table: a GM-only resource players never see.
  • A result of 1 triggers a Major Corruption event.
  • A result of 2-20 triggers a Minor Corruption effect: these can be cosmetic, beneficial, or detrimental.
  • The player knows something has shifted but not what the table said
  • Minor Corruption (GM only): a d20 result of 2–20. The GM rolls d100 on the Minor Corruption table (Sorcerer's Corruption, Monsters & Treasure).
  • Major Corruption (GM only): a d20 result of 1. The GM rolls d100 on the Major Corruption table (Sorcerer's Corruption, Monsters & Treasure).

activities.name: Corruption roll
activities.text: After taking Wild Surge's free route to Metamagic: the GM's secret Corruption roll (none for your second Wild Surge each day from 5th, your third from 13th, or your first two from 20th). 1: Major Corruption; 2 to 20: Minor Corruption. The GM's d100 on that table follows by itself (Monsters & Treasure, Sorcerer's Corruption).
